name: Jessica voice learning
description: Daily scan of phone session logs for AI-like Jessica replies; update friend voice rules when high-confidence.

prompts:
You are improving Jessica's friend voice in the ai_companion repo (ivy-cloud/ai_companion).

## Steps
1. Run the daily learning script:
   cd ai-backend && .venv/bin/python ../scripts/daily_voice_learning.py
2. Read the new section in docs/voice-learning-journal.md and recent ai-backend/data/session_log.jsonl turns.
3. For high-confidence patterns only, update:
   - ai-backend/human_speech.py (BANNED_PHRASES, FRIEND_VOICE_RULES, polish_for_speech)
   - ai-backend/companion_moments.py (vent routing, session openers)
   - ai-backend/personality.py (turn hints)
4. Run tests:
   cd ai-backend && .venv/bin/python -m unittest test_her_companion test_direct_replies test_conversation_rhythm test_memory -v
5. Append findings to docs/voice-learning-journal.md if you made rule changes.

## Constraints
- Friend voice only — no assistant, therapist, or cheerleader patterns.
- Do NOT commit unless the user has configured this automation to commit.
- Do NOT auto-edit human_speech.py for low-confidence journal suggestions.
- Reference docs/natural-human-chat.md for phone test checklist after changes.
